name: reqforge-studio
description: Multi-agent requirement decomposition for Confluence and Jira, with MCP and Teamwork Graph.

reqforge.atlassian.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Atlassian Cloud site base URL, e.g. `https://acme.atlassian.net`.

reqforge.atlassian.email.description: Atlassian account email used with the API token. The token itself is stored in the OS keychain, never in settings.

reqforge.atlassian.transport.markdownDescription: How to talk to Atlassian. `mcp` is only available in the full build.

reqforge.jira.projectKey.description: Target Jira project key, e.g. ACME.

reqforge.jira.epicIssueType.description: Issue type name used for epics.

reqforge.jira.storyIssueType.description: Issue type name used for stories.

reqforge.llm.provider.markdownDescription: Language model backend. `anthropic` is only available in the full build. `fixture` replays recorded responses for offline demos.

reqforge.llm.modelFamily.markdownDescription: Optional Copilot model family to prefer, e.g. `gpt-4o` or `claude-sonnet-4`. Leave blank to use the first available.

reqforge.push.dryRunDefault.description: Push commands preview changes instead of writing to Jira unless explicitly confirmed.

reqforge.workspaceFolder.description: Workspace-relative folder where proposals and the trace file are stored.

reqforge.storageFolder.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a folder where backlog files are stored when no workspace is open. Leave empty to use workspace-relative path.

reqforge.atlassian.mcpEndpoint.markdownDescription: MCP server for the `mcp` transport. Either an `https://` URL, or a command line for a stdio server such as `npx -y mcp-remote https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/sse` — the stdio form owns its own OAuth flow, so no Atlassian credentials pass through ReqForge. Full build only.

commands.title: ReqForge: Decompose Confluence PRD into Epics

viewsWelcome.contents:
Turn a requirements document into a reviewed Jira backlog, or pull an existing epic in to work on.

[Open ReqForge](command:reqforge.open)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke && npm run contract && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run check && REQFORGE_PROFILE=restricted npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --out reqforge-restricted.vsix && node scripts/verifyVsix.mjs reqforge-restricted.vsix restricted
scripts.package:full: npm run check:full && REQFORGE_PROFILE=full npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --out reqforge-studio.vsix && node scripts/verifyVsix.mjs reqforge-studio.vsix full
scripts.hooks: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo "pre-push hook enabled"
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run smoke:full && npm run contract:full && npm run build:full
